scope: Released desktop application at .tools/releases/ecs-cloud/Praxis.exe; existing user window plus isolated sample workspace
changes: Inspection only; sample tasks and project were created in an isolated workspace

findings.observation: Sidebar reports 11 projects and a read error, while the project content shows a first-project empty-state prompt. Root cause of the read error was not diagnosed in this UX inspection.
findings.recommendation: Separate failed loading from an empty project list; preserve known project context and provide one clear recovery action.

findings.observation: Changing priority through the observed path requires opening task details, opening Time and labels, changing the value, previewing attributes, then confirming save. The advanced modal exposes numerous fields for a single change.
findings.recommendation: Edit priority, dates and labels in the task side panel; reserve impact previews for structural or consequential changes.

findings.observation: Quick task opens a long form containing project, priority, plan, deadline, follow-up, labels and waiting fields, followed by preview and confirmation.
findings.recommendation: Start with title, optional date and one Add action. Reveal secondary fields on demand.

findings.observation: The project heading and expanded recovery card occupy most of the initial viewport; task rows begin below the visible area in the sample project.
findings.recommendation: Use a compact project heading and next-action summary; collapse empty recovery fields and keep tasks visible initially.

findings.observation: In a fresh workspace, entering habits, repeated tasks or search first presents the workspace time zone editor instead of the selected tool. It exposes an IANA string and a two-stage confirmation.
findings.recommendation: Initialize a safe device time-zone default for a new workspace; retain explicit impact confirmation when changing an established workspace time zone.

findings.observation: Advanced task and quick-task forms use browser-default double-line fieldsets, inline label/control layout and large scrolling modal content, unlike the styled task side panel.
findings.recommendation: Unify field spacing, labels, selectors, date controls and action bars with the current side-panel visual system.

findings.observation: Repeated tasks stack seven native weekday checkboxes vertically. Search exposes five selectors alongside text, scope and archived-content controls before an explicit apply action.
findings.recommendation: Use weekday chips and common recurrence presets; make search text primary and put secondary filters into compact chips or an expandable panel.

findings.observation: All tasks, projects and sections, time zones and labels, repeat, habits, trash, search, review, notes and quick-task creation share the More menu. Quick-task creation leaves that menu expanded behind its modal.
findings.recommendation: Provide a persistent search entry and a small number of clearly grouped frequent tools; close menus when opening an editor.

retain: Today title entry with Enter is already concise
Current task side panel, project view tabs and theme cards offer a reusable visual baseline
Keep confirmation for restore, structural moves and other consequential actions
